text:
glasses_omar: I assumed static storage spots (bathroom_shelf_ba1, coffee_table_l1) or activity-based locations. Reality: They are consistently at nightstand_b1 in the morning (07:00) and bed_b1 in the evening (21:24). Pattern: Track the bedroom, specifically the nightstand or bed, regardless of time of day. Do not check living room or bathroom shelves.

mug_omar: I incorrectly guessed sink_k1 at 07:33. Reality: It was at kitchen_table_k1. Pattern: In the morning, the mug is at kitchen_table_k1. Do not assume it is being washed or stored in the sink unless explicitly stated.

glass_omar: I repeatedly guessed wrong locations (nightstand_b1, kitchen_table_k1, sink_k1). Reality: It was at counter_k1 (17:54) and cupboard_k1 (21:01, 22:59). Pattern: This glass is not in the bedroom or on the table. It is either on the kitchen counter or stored in the cupboard_k1. Check cupboard_k1 first for evening/night queries, counter_k1 for late afternoon.

water_bottle_omar: I guessed kitchen_table_k1 at 21:01. Reality: It was at dish_rack_k1. Pattern: Check dish_rack_k1 for water bottles in the evening, not the table.

book_omar: I guessed nightstand_b1 at 21:24. Reality: It was at bed_b1. Pattern: Books are on the bed_b1, not the nightstand, in the evening.

General: My previous note about items clustering at bed_b1 was partially correct for glasses and books, but incorrect for kitchen items. Kitchen items (glass, water bottle) have specific storage spots (cupboard, dish rack) distinct from active surfaces. Bedroom items (glasses, books) are on the bed or nightstand, not scattered.
